title.narrative: Cocoa Value Chain Development Programme (COVADEP)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to reduce poverty through increased resilience/competitiveness of the Liberia cocoa sector and improved cocoa farmer livelihoods/food security.The specific objectives are to:1. develop the knowledge, skills and capacity of smallholder cocoa producers for efficient production and improved livelihoods in Liberia,2. develop and implement a cocoa sector public institution, regulatory and policy frameworks in Liberia,3. set up and promote Centres for Cocoa Development (CCDs) as small and medium enterprises (SMEs) within private sector cocoa institutions for sustained delivery of cocoa intensification, rehabilitation and diversification services to farmers/communities in Liberia,4. promote cocoa bean value addition through investment incentives and the setup of incubation centres for entrepreneurship in Liberia, and5. promote market-oriented demand for sustainably produced and/or certified cocoa in Liberia.
